work.primary_language_note: The work is principally Awadhi in Devanagari; approachable Hindi and English meaning are separate consumer layers.

purpose: Let a reader complete the work in source order at their own pace instead of encountering disconnected summaries or scholarly records.

source_denominator.partition_invariant: Every one of the 1,158 text-bearing pages must appear once in source order; the 14 verified blank scan coordinates remain preserved but are not reading units.

reading_modes.boundary: The mode cannot be called complete while 345 text-bearing pages remain held.
A page is tied to this fixed source carrier; another edition may paginate the work differently.
Doha, chaupai and surrounding context must not be split in a way that breaks meaning merely to fit a fixed length.
The seven divisions vary greatly in length; the product does not imply that each must be completed in one day.

label.hi: जहाँ रुके थे वहीं से आगे पढ़ें

reading_modes.boundary: Saved progress is user-controlled product state and must not be inferred from ritual obligation or calendar date.

completion_rule: Complete only when all 1,158 text-bearing pages can be read in exact order, every consumer unit has usable Hindi and English meaning, all five modes preserve the same canonical position, and resume behavior is verified.
